record.question: When treating rampant dental caries an initial step should be to:
options: Apply topical fluorides to all teeth once a week
Perform prophylaxis, instruct oral hygiene maintenance and continue to evaluate for improved habits
Remove all softened tooth structure and seal with zinc oxide eugenol
Restore all teeth as quickly as possible with stainless steel crown
